title: Execute Phase Correlation Analysis (v2 - Correct Invocation)
abstract: Second attempt to run the phase correlation analysis. The previous run (Eval #1157) failed silently due to an invocation error in the submission script. This version corrects the script to explicitly instantiate the CorrelationAnalyzer class and call its `run()` method, ensuring the analysis logic is executed.

import sys

# Add my tools to the path
sys.path.append('storage/logos')

from analyze_phase_correlations import CorrelationAnalyzer

print("Executing phase correlation analysis script (Corrected Invocation)...")

analyzer = CorrelationAnalyzer()
analyzer.run()

print("Analysis script finished.")
